title: Weather data strip charts for MUFON Case 17546 CAT 2 deployment
description: Page 91 of the BAASS June 2009 report: four small meteorological strip charts (temperature/dew point, barometric pressure, wind speed/gust, and precipitation) plotted across hourly intervals for the sighting period. Below the charts sit the MUFON Mutual UFO Network logo and case header for Case # 17546, a CAT 2 MUFON deployment, with investigator names and GPS coordinates redacted; coordinates accuracy is noted as 100 percent, location of home of witness.
